title: Recent changes
description: Who changed what and when: the newest change stamp of every object, filterable by type, file, person and period, with mass events as separate entries and an optional grouping into work sessions.
author: fm-lab core

params.name: type
params.description: Object types, comma-separated (default: all except Account and Authorization).

params.name: person
params.description: Person key from v_change_meta_authors (spelling variants merged).

params.name: days
params.description: Period counted back from the anchor: 7, 30, 90 (default), 365 or all.

params.name: anchor
params.description: Anchor of the period: data (newest individual change, default) or today.

params.name: technical
params.description: Technical authors (tools, runtime sessions): hide (default) or include.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term over object name, type, file and person.

params.name: bulk
params.description: Mass events in the list: hide (default) or include.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of a drill-down window (local time, inclusive); wins over days.

params.name: to
params.description: End of a drill-down window (local time, inclusive).

params.name: group
params.description: Grouping of the list: objects (default) or sessions (work sessions).

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the change or session list (1-based, 100 rows per page).

params.name: count
params.description: Count mode of the activity charts: objects (default) or actions (bursts).

params.name: stack
params.description: Series of the stacked activity chart: type (default), file, person or module (communities of the cluster partition; without one, files).

params.name: charts
params.description: Activity charts above the list: show (default) or hide.
